messages:
nina: Following up on the PM for the gen-serve memory spike 

nina: we identified three remediation tracks: eviction policy, graceful fallback, and ops handoff clarity. need owners and acceptance criteria.

tom: I can pick eviction policy. will add perf counters + a dashboard.

lee: i'll take graceful fallback. prefer a shorter-context variant + metrics to ensure quality preserved.

darya: i'll own ops handoff/playbook + run a drill with night oncall.

nina: thanks. proposed tickets: RDX-7102 (eviction metrics & fix) owner @tom due 2026-04-02, RDX-7103 (fallback routing + canary) owner @lee due 2026-04-09, RDX-7104 (oncall playbook + drill) owner @darya due 2026-03-31.

ops-bot: Created RDX-7102, RDX-7103, RDX-7104 8; https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-7102 https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-7103 https://jira.redwood/r/RDX-7104

tom: acceptance: instrument per-model kv size, add unit that simulates heavy eviction, dashboard tile, and alert when eviction rate >2x baseline. ETA 2026-04-02.

lee: acceptance: implement shorter-context model variant route, add canary test that forces fallback, and SLA smoke verifying latency under fallback. ETA 2026-04-09.

darya: acceptance: updated playbook with explicit handover script + timezone conversion table + two runbook drills scheduled. ETA 2026-03-31.

nina: RACI quick: R=owners above, A=eng-sre for rollout approvals, C=product for comms, I=postmortem author + oncall.

tom: flag: eviction might be symptomatic of an upstream KV size regression from recent quantization change. will add a bisect plan to the ticket.

lee: noted. if quantization change is root cause we should also add Q-profile rollback to mitigation steps.

darya: drill note: ops needs a short checklist for escalation thresholds (mem %, duration) and where to route to (regional SRE or global). adding to ticket.

nina: can each owner paste one-line acceptance in the ticket now? i'll compile a remediation matrix and sync next Tue 10am PT.

tom: done in RDX-7102.

lee: done in RDX-7103, linked canary doc.

darya: done in RDX-7104, scheduled drills for 3/29 & 4/2.

ops-bot: Updated ticket statuses to "In Progress" for RDX-7102, RDX-7103, RDX-7104.

nina: great. one more ask: add a recurring agenda item to the postmortem monthly review to detect repeating patterns across gen-serve pools. this should help prevent bounce-back incidents.

darya: agreed. putting it on the monthly PM review board.

lee: will also add a short eval in the nightly regression job to catch memory growth over 24h.

tom: will coordinate with infra to ensure the new counters don't blow up metrics ingestion.

nina: thanks everyone 1. closing this thread; i'll post the consolidated matrix to the PM doc and mark the postmortem as "actions assigned". reopen if anything slips.
